Denmark badge [...] Denmark sit second in the group and will be without two significant players. Barcelona centre-back Andreas Christensen remains sidelined with a thigh injury sustained in September, while Manchester United's Patrick Dorgu has also been ruled out. Brian Riemer's side have leaned on Joachim Andersen and Oliver Provstgaard at the back and have shown resilience across recent fixtures. [...] The Danes will be motivated by the reverse fixture result. Portugal won 4-2 in Copenhagen in October, and Denmark will want to settle that score on Portuguese soil.

Rafael Leao's fitness is also a concern for the hosts after the Galatasaray forward was withdrawn at half-time during a Super Lig match on November 8, though he described the issue as nothing serious and expects to have further assessments completed before the squad assembles.

data.title: Portugal Cristiano Ronaldo No. 7 Tribute Set for Denmark Clash in Braga Saturday - Yahoo Sports
data.content:
The occasion is significant, but there is still a competitive match to play. Portugal have won all four of their Group A4 matches and already secured a place in the Nations League quarter-finals. They lead the group with 12 points, six ahead of Denmark, and a draw on Saturday would guarantee top spot.

Advertisement

Advertisement [...] There will also be a quieter reminder of Ronaldo's importance away from the stadium. His usual room at the national team's training base, Cidade do Futebol, has reportedly been left unassigned during the current camp. It is another small but meaningful gesture as Portugal begin their first international gathering without him since his retirement announcement.

## A 23-Year Portugal Career That Changed the National Team [...] Advertisement

Denmark will be looking to spoil the celebration and strengthen their own position. Portugal won the reverse fixture 4-2 in Copenhagen in October, but the visitors will have plenty of motivation to produce a different result in Braga.
